summary: Russian forces deployed jet-powered Geran-5 UAVs equipped with new shaped-charge warheads designed to destroy high-voltage pylons and railway bridges in a massive overnight barrage targeting Kyiv and at least ten other Ukrainian regions. The attack triggered emergency power and water outages in Kyiv, Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Zhytomyr oblasts. Meanwhile, the Russian Ministry of Defense claimed 123 Ukrainian UAVs were shot down over Russian regions and the Black Sea.
key_points: Russian jet-powered UAVs used new 40 kg shaped-charge warheads with four strike modules to target high-voltage pylons and railway bridges for the first time. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33631)

Overnight drone barrage launched from multiple directions including Chernihiv, Donetsk, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Kyiv, Vinnytsia regions targeting Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Khmelnytskyi, Rivne, Cherkasy, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, Chernihiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75992)
Emergency power and water outages implemented in Kyiv, Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Zhytomyr oblasts due to numerous Russian attacks. (Source: @eRadarrua/119105, @UkraineNow/84403)
Russian MoD reported shooting down 123 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions and Black Sea in one day. (Source: @tass_agency/398147)
Ukrainian drone production lacks turbojet engines, relying on complex third-country procurement and salvage, while Russia has domestic production and Chinese supply. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33630)
McDonald's Ukraine reducing menu after Russian strike on logistics partner's warehouse. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33621)
Half of Ukrainian F-16s grounded awaiting mandatory 300-hour maintenance in Belgium due to repair delays. (Source: @UkraineNow/84400)
Warning issued of possible Kalibr, Iskander-M, Zircon, and Onyx missile strikes in coming days. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75995)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces deployed jet-powered Geran-5 UAVs equipped with new shaped-charge warheads designed to destroy high-voltage pylons and railway bridges in a massive overnight barrage targeting Kyiv and at least ten other Ukrainian regions. The attack triggered emergency power and water outages in Kyiv, Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Zhytomyr oblasts. Meanwhile, the Russian Ministry of Defense claimed 123 Ukrainian UAVs were shot down over Russian regions and the Black Sea.

points: Ukrainian drone manufacturers lack turbojet engines for jet-powered UAVs, forcing reliance on complex third-country procurement schemes and salvage from other equipment, while Russia has established domestic production and purchases from China. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33630)
McDonald's Ukraine is reducing its menu across the country following a Russian attack on a logistics partner's warehouse, disrupting supply chains. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33621, @UkraineNow/84392)

Approximately half of Ukraine's F-16 fleet cannot perform combat missions due to delays in mandatory 300-hour maintenance inspections conducted in Belgium, creating a significant capability gap. (Source: @UkraineNow/84400)

The State Bureau of Investigation uncovered a fraud scheme involving the purchase of 24 tons of substandard medicinal mud for a rehabilitation center, resulting in nearly 1 million hryvnias in losses; four officials and company representatives were served suspicion notices. (Source: @UkraineNow/84401)

Emergency power outages are in effect across Kyiv, Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Zhytomyr oblasts due to extensive damage from Russian drone attacks on energy infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/84403, @eRadarrua/119105)

Ukrainian UAVs continued attacks on Russian regions including Belgorod, Bryansk, Voronezh, Kostroma, Penza, Tula, and Saratov, with one UAV shot down in Kostroma without casualties; airport restrictions imposed in Volga and central Russia. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

In the LNR, Ukrainian UAVs attacked vehicles on the Lugansk-Alchevsk road killing one and injuring another, with additional vehicle attacks reported in Troitsk municipal district and Lisichansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

Russian jet-powered UAVs (Geran-5) employed a new warhead type for the first time: a 40 kg shaped-charge cutting payload with four strike modules specifically designed to destroy high-voltage pylons and railway bridge structures. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33631)

Massive overnight combined strike utilized jet-powered Shahed/Geran UAVs launched from at least six directions (Chernihiv, Donetsk, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Kyiv, Vinnytsia) targeting Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Khmelnytskyi, Rivne, Cherkasy, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75992, @kpszsu/81986, @kpszsu/81987, @kpszsu/81989, @kpszsu/81992, @kpszsu/81994, @kpszsu/81995, @kpszsu/81999, @kpszsu/82014)
Russian Ministry of Defense claimed air defenses destroyed 123 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions and the Black Sea in a single day. (Source: @tass_agency/398147)

Russian authorities issued a warning of possible imminent strikes using Kalibr cruise missiles, Iskander-M ballistic missiles, Zircon hypersonic missiles, and Onyx anti-ship missiles. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75995)
President Putin held a videoconference meeting with newly elected regional heads across Russia. (Source: @tass_agency/398118)

Russian Foreign Ministry summoned the Danish ambassador to protest an incident involving a Danish Air Force helicopter maneuvering near a Russian warship, calling it a violation of the UN Convention. (Source: @tass_agency/398144)

Cardinal Matteo Zuppi, Pope's envoy on Ukraine, visited Moscow to discuss humanitarian aspects; Russian MFA informed him of a humanitarian crisis in Aleshki due to Ukrainian actions. (Source: @tass_agency/398141, @tass_agency/398143)

On the Kupyansk direction, intense fighting continues in the Kupyansk agglomeration and north of the city, with both sides contesting protrusions and supply lines rather than seeking deep breakthroughs. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

On the Krasnolimansk direction, clashes persist along the Zherebets River near Zarechnoye, Yampol, and north of Lyman; Ukrainian forces attempt to push back Russian units but fighting remains positional over individual positions and wooded areas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

On the Druzhkivka direction, Ukrainian forces counterattack near Alekseevo-Druzhkivka and Kurdyumivka while Russian units maintain pressure toward Druzhkivka; Russian MoD announced control over Veseloye Pole in neighboring Dobropillia district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

On the Zaporizhzhia front, the Vostok group reported Russian advances on several sectors: west of Zorevka, west of Rovnoye and Kopany, north of Yegorovka, and west of Chervona Krynytsia; strikes recorded near Terny, Gavrilovka, Kolomiyets, Podgavrilovka, Velikomykhailovka, Novoukrainka, and Tarasovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

On the Kherson direction, no significant changes in the contact line; reciprocal artillery and UAV fire continues across the Dnipro River with focus on striking enemy positions, transport, UAV control points, and rear infrastructure. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

On the Sumy front, the Sever group reported advances near Malaya Rybitsa, Kiyanitsa, and Khoteni, expanding the control zone around Ulanovo; two servicemen of Ukraine's 5th Border Guard Detachment captured in Shostka district; TOS thermobaric systems used against positions in Krasnopillia district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)
Russian aviation, artillery, and UAVs struck areas near Sumy, Rovnoye, Boyaro-Lezhachi, Yastrebino, Khoteni, Vakalovshchina, Lebedin, Stepivka, Pustomyhorod, and Turya. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

On the Kharkiv front, Russian MoD announced establishment of control over Kraydyanka; fighting reported near Nesterynoye, Lukashovo, Grachevka, Rublenoye, and Reznikovoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

Sever group reported advances on Liptsy direction up to 300 meters on three sectors; on Volchansk direction advances up to 500 meters near Varvarovka and Nesterynoye; on Velikiy Burluk direction assault groups advancing near Reznikovoye and Kolodeznoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)
Strikes carried out in Dergachi, Pitomnik, Reznikovoye, Chernoe, Russkiye Tishki, Zarechnoye, and Khatnoye areas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

In Belgorod region, Ukrainian FPV drone detonated near a road in Shebekino injuring one man; in Bessonovka a UAV detonation seriously injured one man and hospitalized two others with shrapnel wounds; strikes on Shebekino, Repyakhovka, and Vyazovoye damaged housing, vehicles, and infrastructure. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

In Bryansk region, high UAV and FPV activity; railway infrastructure attacks damaged tracks on Trosna-Rzhanitsa section while a passenger train passed (no casualties); traffic restored on Rzhanitsa-Trosna and Zlynka-Unecha sections. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)
On the Zaporizhzhia front, Russian assault groups advanced west of Zorevka, west of Rovnoye and Kopany, north of Yegorovka, and west of Chervona Krynytsia. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)
Russian strikes recorded in Zaporizhzhia sector near Terny, Gavrilovka, Kolomiyets, Podgavrilovka, Velikomykhailovka, Novoukrainka, and Tarasovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)
On the Kherson direction, no significant changes in the contact line; reciprocal artillery and UAV fire continues across the Dnipro River. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)
Main efforts focused on striking enemy positions, transport, UAV control points, and infrastructure in the rear across the Dnipro. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)
Jet-powered UAVs detected over Mykolaiv region heading toward Voznesensk, and over northern Zaporizhzhia region moving northeast. (Source: @kpszsu/82014, @kpszsu/81999)

Russian forces introduced a new warhead for jet-powered Geran-5 UAVs: a 40 kg shaped-charge cutting payload with four strike modules designed to sever high-voltage pylons and railway bridges, marking a significant escalation in infrastructure targeting. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33631)

Massive overnight drone wave included multiple Geran-5 rockets over Korosten and Kyiv, conventional Shaheds over Dubno (Rivne), and numerous jet-powered Shaheds targeting Kyiv (right bank), Zhytomyr, Starokostiantyniv (Khmelnytskyi), Chisinau (Moldova), Smila (Cherkasy), Mykolaiv, Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Zaporizhzhia regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75962, @mon1tor_ua/75964, @mon1tor_ua/75981, @mon1tor_ua/75984, @mon1tor_ua/75990, @mon1tor_ua/75993, @mon1tor_ua/75994, @mon1tor_ua/75998, @kpszsu/81972, @kpszsu/81986, @kpszsu/81987, @kpszsu/81989, @kpszsu/81992, @kpszsu/81994, @kpszsu/81995, @kpszsu/81999, @kpszsu/82014)

Air alerts declared across Kyiv (yellow level) with multiple activation periods; drones observed circling near Kozyn after exiting Kyiv airspace. (Source: @eRadarrua/119187, @eRadarrua/119159, @eRadarrua/119192)
Russian MoD claimed 123 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed over Russian regions and Black Sea in 24 hours. (Source: @tass_agency/398147)
Ukrainian F-16 fleet readiness severely impacted: half the aircraft grounded awaiting 300-hour mandatory maintenance in Belgium due to repair backlogs. (Source: @UkraineNow/84400)
Warning issued of potential imminent strikes using Kalibr, Iskander-M, Zircon, and Onyx missiles. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75995)

Ukrainian UAV attacks on Russian regions (Belgorod, Bryansk, Voronezh, Kostroma, Penza, Tula, Saratov) prompted airport restrictions in Volga and central Russia; one UAV downed in Kostroma without damage. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)

Massive overnight drone barrage launched from six directions struck Kyiv and nine other oblasts, triggering emergency power/water outages in Kyiv, Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Zhytomyr regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75992, @eRadarrua/119105, @UkraineNow/84403)
Russian air defenses claimed 123 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed over Russian territory and Black Sea in a single day, indicating high-intensity Ukrainian long-range strikes. (Source: @tass_agency/398147)

Ukraine's jet-powered drone program critically hampered by turbojet engine shortage, relying on third-country procurement and salvage while Russia enjoys domestic production and Chinese supply. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33630)
Half of Ukraine's F-16 fleet non-operational due to 300-hour maintenance backlog in Belgium, creating a significant air capability gap. (Source: @UkraineNow/84400)

Russian forces advancing on multiple eastern front sectors: up to 500 meters near Volchansk, 300 meters near Liptsy, and gains west of Zorevka, Rovnoye, and Chervona Krynytsia in Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33619)
Imminent missile strike warning issued for Kalibr, Iskander-M, Zircon, and Onyx systems, suggesting potential escalation to combined missile-drone attacks. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75995)
sections.threat_assessment: The introduction of specialized shaped-charge warheads on Russian jet-powered UAVs represents a deliberate escalation in infrastructure warfare, targeting the structural integrity of high-voltage pylons and railway bridges rather than merely causing electrical shorts. Combined with the massive multi-axis drone barrage and explicit warnings of impending Kalibr/Iskander/Zircon/Onyx missile strikes, Russia appears to be executing a coordinated campaign to degrade Ukraine's energy and transport networks ahead of winter. Ukraine's critical shortage of turbojet engines for its own long-range drones, coupled with F-16 maintenance bottlenecks, severely limits its ability to retaliate symmetrically or interdict Russian launch platforms. The capture of Ukrainian border guards in Sumy and advances near Volchansk and Liptsy suggest Russian ground pressure continues to exploit Ukrainian manpower shortages. The threat of combined missile-drone strikes in the coming days raises the probability of widespread, prolonged blackouts.
sections.regional_response: Moldova's airspace was violated by a Russian jet-powered Shahed heading toward Chisinau, highlighting the regional spillover risk of Russia's long-range drone operations. Denmark's ambassador was summoned to the Russian MFA over a helicopter incident near a Russian warship, indicating heightened Baltic/North Sea tensions. The Vatican's envoy Cardinal Zuppi visited Moscow to discuss humanitarian corridors, specifically the Aleshki flooding crisis blamed on Ukrainian actions, showing continued diplomatic engagement despite battlefield escalation. Emergency power outages across four Ukrainian oblasts demonstrate the immediate civilian impact of infrastructure targeting. McDonald's menu reduction in Ukraine signals commercial sector vulnerability to logistics disruptions. No immediate NATO or EU policy responses were indicated in the source data.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Geran-5's new warhead — 40 kg main charge with four strike modules — suggests Russian engineers have developed a purpose-built anti-infrastructure munition, likely informed by previous attacks on Ukrainian energy grids. The multi-directional launch pattern (Chernihiv, Donetsk, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Kyiv, Vinnytsia) indicates a distributed launch architecture designed to saturate air defenses and complicate interception. Ukrainian reliance on third-country turbojet procurement via "complex schemes" points to persistent supply chain vulnerabilities that Western sanctions have not fully closed for Russia, which benefits from domestic production and Chinese imports. The F-16 maintenance backlog in Belgium reveals a critical sustainment bottleneck that Western partners have not resolved despite months of operational deployment. The Two Majors summary's granular front-line details (300-500 meter advances, specific village names, TOS usage) suggest Russian offensive operations remain methodical and localized rather than large-scale breakthrough attempts.
